title: Dungeon Train flags
summary: Builders get eight new Dungeon Train flags for their carriages. Each one turns into a Dungeon Train banner when the carriage appears, with a new design for every carriage.
highlights: Flag 1 to Flag 8 in the Stage Blocks tab, placed on the floor or on a wall
Every copy of the same flag number in a carriage matches, and different numbers never repeat a design
Break one to keep it as a Dungeon Train banner
Dungeon Train flags can now turn up in the shop and dressing room carriages
